```{r load packages and seurat objects}

library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)

#sobjs_all_cd8 = readRDS("sobjs_all_final.rds")
sobjs_all = readRDS("/krummellab/data1/DSCoLab/AMFAR/analysis/10x/3.rna_integration_wnnUMAPClust_adtUpDown_rnaUp_cutoffs_v3/sobjs_all_final_wRes0.6_sub9_sub12.rds")

# Adding broad annotation to the full object
annot = read.csv("/krummellab/data1/DSCoLab/AMFAR/analysis/10x/3.rna_integration_wnnUMAPClust_adtUpDown_rnaUp_cutoffs_v3/annotation_res0.6.csv")
sobjs_all$broad_annot = annot$broad_annotation[ match( sobjs_all$wsnn_harmony_res.0.6_sub, annot$cluster ) ]


```


### Preprocessing of TCR data

1. Reading in the TCR data for all pools
2. Removing the chains that are not productive
3. Defining the chain as vgene_jgene_cdr3
4. Plotting length distribution for TRA and TRB chains

There are no chains shorter than 5 aa, but there are a few chains longer than 22 aa. Removing all chains longer than 22 aa.
```{r}

tcr = data.frame()
for(i in 1:15) {
  tcr = rbind(tcr, 
    read.csv(paste0("/krummellab/data1/immunox/AMFAR/processed_vdj_data/AMFAR-POOL-RR",i,"-SCG1/vdj_t/all_contig_annotations.csv")) %>% mutate(barcode = paste0("AMFAR-POOL-RR",i,"-SCG1_", barcode))
    )
}
tcr_hq = tcr[tcr$barcode %in% Cells(sobjs_all) & tcr$productive == 'true', ]
tcr_hq$vjcdr3 = paste0(tcr_hq$v_gene, "_", tcr_hq$j_gene, "_", tcr_hq$cdr3)

# Calculating cdr3 length
tcr_hq = tcr_hq %>% mutate(c3len = nchar(cdr3))

# Plotting length distribution for TRA and TRB chains
tcr_hq %>% ggplot(aes(as.factor(c3len))) + geom_bar() + theme_classic() + facet_wrap(~chain)

# Removing chains longer than 22 aa
tcr_hq = tcr_hq[ tcr_hq$c3len <= 22, ]

```


```{r}
#tcr_hq = tcr[tcr$barcode %in% Cells(sobjs_all_cd8) & tcr$productive == 'true', ]
#tcr_hq$vjcdr3 = paste0(tcr_hq$v_gene, "_", tcr_hq$j_gene, "_", tcr_hq$cdr3)


clonotype_tcr_file = "/krummellab/data1/DSCoLab/AMFAR/analysis/10x/3.rna_integration_wnnUMAPClust_adtUpDown_rnaUp_cutoffs_v3/clonotype_tcr.rds"
if(file.exists(clonotype_tcr_file)) {
  clonotype_tcr = readRDS(clonotype_tcr_file) 
} else {
  clonotype_hq = data.frame()
  bc_count = 0
  for(bc in unique(tcr_hq$barcode)) {
    bc_count = bc_count + 1
    if(bc_count %% 1000 == 0)
      cat(bc_count, "/", length(unique(tcr_hq$barcode)), "\n")
    tmp = tcr_hq[ tcr_hq$barcode == bc, ] %>% arrange(chain)
    all_vjc3 = ""
    all_c3 = ""
    for(i in seq_len(nrow(tmp))) {
      all_vjc3 = paste0(all_vjc3, tmp$chain[i], ":", tmp$vjcdr3[i], ";")
      all_c3 = paste0(all_c3, tmp$chain[i], ":", tmp$cdr3[i], ";")
    }
    clonotype_hq = rbind(
      clonotype_hq,
      data.frame(barcode=bc, tcr_vjcdr3=all_vjc3, tcr_cdr3 = all_c3, tra_count = sum(tmp$chain == "TRA"), trb_count = sum(tmp$chain == "TRB")))
  }
  
  clonotype_hq_tcr = clonotype_hq
  saveRDS(clonotype_hq_tcr, "/krummellab/data1/DSCoLab/AMFAR/analysis/10x/3.rna_integration_wnnUMAPClust_adtUpDown_rnaUp_cutoffs_v3/clonotype_tcr.rds")
}



# Bar plot of chain type freq 
p = data.frame(
  nchain = paste0("a", clonotype_tcr$tra_count, "-b", clonotype_tcr$trb_count)
  ) %>% ggplot(aes(nchain)) + geom_bar() + theme_classic() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1, vjust=1))

pct_format = scales::percent_format(accuracy = .1)

p + geom_text(
    aes(
        label = sprintf(
            '%d (%s)',
            ..count..,
            pct_format(..count.. / sum(..count..))
        )
    ),
    stat = 'count',
    nudge_y = 5000, nudge_x = 0.4,
    colour = 'black',
    size = 3, angle=25, vjust=1
)




# Bar plot of chain type freq by broad cell type, restricting to chain types with > 1000 counts.
p2 = data.frame(
  nchain = paste0("a", clonotype_tcr$tra_count, "-b", clonotype_tcr$trb_count), 
  annot = sobjs_all$broad_annot[ match(clonotype_tcr$barcode, Cells(sobjs_all) ) ]
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(nchain %in% names(which(table(nchain) > 1000)) ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(nchain, fill=annot)) + geom_bar() + theme_classic() + theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1, vjust=1)) + scale_fill_manual(values = pals::kelly(22)[-1])

pct_format = scales::percent_format(accuracy = .1)

p2 + ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(
        label = sprintf(
            '%d\n%s',
            ..count..,
            pct_format(..count.. / sum(..count..))
        )
    ),
    stat = 'count', position = position_stack(0.5), 
    colour = 'black',
    size = 3, angle=0
)


```
